cards.title: Oscilloscope in the web page with an on/off button
cards.description: A 440 Hz sine wave generated by the Rust engine (WASM in an AudioWorklet), played in the web page with an on/off button and shown live on an oscilloscope.

tasks.title: engine-core: 440 Hz sine oscillator (no_std, libm, fixed block size)
engine-cli: offline WAV render + reference hash
engine-wasm + AudioWorklet glue (no wasm-bindgen on the audio path)
Web page: on/off button + live oscilloscope
Tests: same hash native and WASM, end-to-end on 4 browsers, CI and pre-push hook
